persona: apparel art director for independent labels

designs.why: The joke lands at 3 m: a huge condensed title, one bold curve climbing off the top edge, and the minivan sitting off the curve is the punchline. One ink, clean line work, and a layout that is balanced and printable. Weaknesses: the vehicles' hairline detail will go soft on cotton, the dots sit far from their vehicles (scooter, bike, minivan) so the data-point link is loose, and the minivan's dot is tiny and easy to miss, which weakens the gag. The axis labels are small and the lower area feels a bit empty.
designs.fix: Make the minivan punchline unmissable: enlarge its dot and move it closer to the van. Then thicken the vehicle outlines slightly so they hold up in screenprint.
designs.title: Horsepower vs. Poor Decisions
